content:
# Client Onboarding Workflow
#
# Format: documentation spec. No automation engine consumes this file yet;
# structure is generic YAML so it can be ported to a workflow tool later.
#
# Assumptions (adjust as needed):
# - Trigger is manual: a team member starts onboarding for each new client.
# - Steps run in sequence; each has an owner role and completion criteria.

name: client_onboarding
version: 0.2.0
description: Workflow for onboarding new clients from intake through kickoff.

trigger:
  type: manual
  actor: account_manager

steps:
  - id: intake
    name: Contract & paperwork
    owner: account_manager
    actions:
      - Send contract for signature
      - Collect intake form (company info, billing contact, key stakeholders)
    completion_criteria: Contract signed and intake form received
    on_block: Escalate to sales lead after 5 business days without response

  - id: provisioning
    name: Account provisioning
    owner: engineering
    depends_on: [intake]
    actions:
      - Create client account and environments
      - Issue credentials and access
      - Configure integrations requested at intake
    completion_criteria: Client can log in and access all provisioned resources
    on_block: File engineering ticket; escalate after 3 business days

  - id: kickoff
    name: Kickoff call
    owner: account_manager
    depends_on: [provisioning]
    actions:
      - Schedule kickoff within 5 business days of provisioning
      - Present timeline, points of contact, and success criteria
      - Record client requirements and open questions
    completion_criteria: Meeting held and notes shared with all stakeholders
    on_block: Reschedule once; escalate to CS lead if client is unresponsive

  - id: welcome
    name: Welcome communications
    owner: account_manager
    depends_on: [kickoff]
    actions:
      - Send welcome email with guides and next steps
      - Add client to status-update cadence
    completion_criteria: Welcome pack delivered and cadence scheduled
    on_block: Send manually if automated delivery fails
